title: fix(plugin-auth): the register form's Application Type reaches the OAuth provider as application_type
body:
Part of #24773: half 2a, the `plugin-auth` part of the maintainer's ruling D (`6293344532`). Half 1 (a refusal answered 500) landed as #24853. Half 2b (the form's options and help text in `platform-objects`) stays on the card.

Clause-②: no — the declared type now takes effect under the OAuth provider's own redirect-URI rule, an authentication behaviour the maintainer ruled on; nothing published widens.

## What changes

`POST /api/v1/auth/sys-oauth-application/register` (Setup → OAuth Applications → Register) forwarded the form's Application Type as `type`. The installed `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.3 declares `application_type` (`web` | `native`) on its `/oauth2/create-client` body and no `type`, so the member was stripped and every client was judged and stored as `web`.

The register wrapper now maps the value onto `application_type`:

| Form value | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `web` | judged and stored as web | unchanged (now sent as `application_type: 'web'`) |
| `native` | judged and stored as **web**: `http://localhost:4001/callback` refused | judged as native: http on exactly `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` or `[::1]` (any port) accepted and stored as `native`; other http refused |
| `user-agent-based`, `public`, any other value | web, silently | web, as before, plus **one server warning** per registration naming the value |
| absent | web | web, no warning |

- The provider's own rule is the only rule. The wrapper does not judge a URI. Web still needs https on a non-loopback host.
- Half 1's error mapping is unchanged: `resolveThrownHttpError(err, 500)` and the `400 OAUTH_REGISTER_FAILED` refusal, with `details.upstreamError`.
- The warning is a server log line (`ctx.logger.warn`, meta `{ requestedType, registeredAs: 'web' }`). No response field was added. This door answers `{ success, data: { client } }`, which has no warnings member. The `warnings` member on the data-layer write answers (`CreateDataResponseSchema`, `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) is declared as advisory validation-rule hits, so it does not fit here. The warning does not reach the Console caller.
- Diff: `auth-plugin.ts` (the register wrapper only, +32 / -3), one new test file, one changeset. 382 changed lines in total.

## 「甲」 reading

Standing rule 「甲」 (#6015 `6292005854`) applied as ruled in `6293344532`:

- **Ships in 18.x.** Honouring the declared type is a fix. `web` and `native` are forwarded, and Native gets the provider's RFC 8252 loopback rule. Other values get the loud half: one warning per registration.
- **Waits for 19.0.** A 400 for `user-agent-based` / `public` / any other value narrows what the door accepts, and no ADR-0087 conversion carries it. Removing the two options from the form is half 2b, not this PR.
- **`public`, measured first.** 1.7.3 has a real counterpart. A public client is `token_endpoint_auth_method: 'none'`, and `persistOAuthClientRegistration` then issues and stores no client secret. It is a separate axis from `application_type`, which has no `public` value. Per the dispatch, it is not forwarded or mapped. The mapping question goes to the seat, with options, in the dev report on the card. Here `public` behaves like `user-agent-based`: registered as a confidential web client with a secret, plus the warning.
- **The exception's reading, for the seat to record and rule.** The question is whether any stored row or any caller ever sent `user-agent-based` / `public`. The answer does not establish the exception.
  - **Stored rows, console door.** Measured on a real ObjectQL + SQLite engine with the auth manifest's objects: on base `78ab6474c` and on this head, a registration with `user-agent-based`, `public` or `spa` stores `type = 'web'`, `public` null and `token_endpoint_auth_method = 'client_secret_basic'`. No column holds the form's value. 1.7.3 accepts only `web` / `native` for `application_type` on create and on update.
  - **Earlier provider lines,** read from their npm tarballs, not installed here:
    - `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.0-rc.2 and 1.6.33 declared `type` (`web` | `native` | `user-agent-based`) but refused any non-`web` type on a confidential client. The door never sends `token_endpoint_auth_method`, so `user-agent-based` was refused there, and the wrapper coerced `public` to `web`.
    - better-auth 1.6.33's `oidc-provider` wrote `type: "web"` on every registration.
  - **Limits of this reading.**
    - Repo history before 2026-09-07 (`ac76425f0`, this checkout's shallow root) was not read.
    - Rows that other doors wrote under the older lines cannot be measured. Under rc.2 and 1.6.x, the SDK and DCR accepted `user-agent-based` for public clients.
  - **Callers.**
    - In this repo, zero producers send either value to the door: tests, examples, `packages/qa`, docs and the SDK (which never builds this URL).
    - HotCRM `main` `1cc6861a3`: zero hits for the door path, `user-agent-based`, `application_type`, `oauth2/create-client` and `applications.register` (control: case-insensitive `oauth`, 18 files).
    - objectui `origin/main` `12cde0492`: zero hardcoded values (control: `sys_oauth_application`, 5 files).
    - The one live producer is the Console form itself. `sys-oauth-application.object.ts:153-158` offers both values to every admin. Whether an admin ever picked one cannot be measured, because there is no request log.

## Tests

New `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-register-application-type.test.ts`, 15 cases. It runs real better-auth (OIDC provider on) behind the plugin's real route registration, on a real Hono app, over a real ObjectQL engine on SQLite. "Stored as" is read from `sys_oauth_application.type` at driver level.

- Preconditions on the provider itself:
  - `type: 'native'` is stripped: the loopback URI is refused with `invalid_redirect_uri`.
  - `application_type: 'native'` accepts the same URI and stores `native`.
- Web + `http://localhost:4001/callback`: refused, `400 OAUTH_REGISTER_FAILED`, `invalid_redirect_uri`. Nothing stored, no warning.
- Native + `http://localhost:4001/callback` and + `http://127.0.0.1:4001/callback`: `200`, stored `native`, no warning.
- Native + `http://app.example.com/callback`: refused, `400`, nothing stored. The provider's body schema (`SafeUrlSchema`, https except on loopback hosts) refuses it before its per-type rule.
- Native + `http://127.0.0.2:4001/callback`: refused by the provider's exact-host native rule (`invalid_redirect_uri`).
- Web + https and no type: stored `web`, no warning.
- `user-agent-based`, `public`, `spa` + https: stored `web`, no column holds the value, no public client (no secret-less row), exactly one warning with meta `{ requestedType, registeredAs: 'web' }`.
- `user-agent-based`, `public`, `spa` + loopback: refused as web, nothing stored, exactly one warning.

Before the fix, on `78ab6474c`: `Tests 9 failed | 5 passed (14)`. The native-localhost and native-127.0.0.1 cases got the web refusal (`expected 400 to be 200`). The six unhonoured-type cases failed only on the warning count (`expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`), after their storage assertions had passed. The ninth failure was this file's own first assertion on the non-loopback native case. It expected `invalid_redirect_uri`, but the provider's body schema refuses that URI before its per-type rule, both before and after the fix. The assertion was corrected after this run.

After, at head `e9f4debc1`:

- This file and half 1's `oauth-register-refusal-status.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 32 passed (32)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run`, at `d674628b9`: `Test Files 174 passed (174)`, `Tests 3334 passed | 10 skipped (3344)`. The plugin-auth tree is byte-identical at `e9f4debc1`; the merge of `main` brought only the objectui pin.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck: OK`, 23 pinned signatures held, no new debt. The new file is in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (`--listFilesOnly`, 1 hit).

## Ablation (one-shot; no permanent file)

Each leg went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor hit exactly once, and the mutation was verified on disk (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed). The runner had its own EXIT/INT/TERM trap. Each restore was verified as blob `01004ce16` == HEAD, with `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./auth-plugin` from source, so no `dist` is involved.

| Leg | Mutation (the forbidden behaviour put back) | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | `application_type: applicationType` → `type: applicationType` (the old `type` forwarding) | `Tests 2 failed \| 13 passed`: native + localhost / 127.0.0.1, `expected 400 to be 200` (the web refusal) |
| 2 | `applicationType = type` → `applicationType = 'native'` (web judged as native) | `2 failed`: web + localhost `expected 200 to be 400`; web + https stored `native` |
| 3 | unhonoured values forwarded as `native` | `6 failed`: all six unhonoured-type cases |
| 4 | the door rewrites the URI to one the provider accepts (`http://app.` → `https://app.`, `127.0.0.2` → `127.0.0.1`) | `2 failed`: both native negative pins, `expected 200 to be 400` |

The first attempt at leg 3 used an anchor that the replacement still contained. The tool refused it (`anchor count moved 1 -> 1`), restored, and ran nothing. It was redone with a non-overlapping anchor. The reading above is from the redone run.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head `e9f4debc1` derived 72 commands. That list is identical to the seat's derivation at `78ab6474c`. Each command was run with `cmd > log 2>&1; rc=$?`.

- **Result.** 72/72 exit 0. This includes `check:adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:changeset-no-major`, `check:empty-changeset`, `check:closing-keyword-parity`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:auth-mount-ledger`, `check:durability-log-level`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:engine-double-contract` and `check:type-check-debt`.
- **`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`.** It first exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, no whole-repo `dist`). It passed after `turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs` (76 tasks, 75 from cache): 112 require entry points across 69 packages load.
- **Reconciliation.** `--ran` printed `Run reconciliation — 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- **Not run locally.**
  - `test:repo`: CI `Test Core`.
  - `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness`: no `packages/spec` build input or frame file is touched.
  - The workspace type-check lanes and the CI-only jobs that `dispatch-gates` lists outside the 72: CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **`user-agent-based` has a partial counterpart too.** In the provider's rc.2 and 1.6.x lines, `user-agent-based` was valid only for a public client (`token_endpoint_auth_method: 'none'`). In 1.7.x a browser public client is `application_type: 'web'` plus `token_endpoint_auth_method: 'none'`. So the `public` mapping question covers both form values. MCP clients already register as public native clients through DCR (`auth-manager.mcp-oauth-resource.test.ts:235`).
- **SDK.** `oauth.applications.register` (`packages/client/src/index.ts:4535`) does not declare `application_type` on its request type. It does declare `token_endpoint_auth_method: 'none'`, and its response type `OAuthApplication` declares `application_type`. The body passes through unchanged, so a typed caller can register a native client only through a cast. Noted, not filed. Carrier: none (承接者:无).
- **For half 2b.**
  - The stored column `sys_oauth_application.type` (`sys-oauth-application.object.ts:425`) also lists `user-agent-based` and `public`, which 1.7.3 never writes.
  - The `public` boolean column (`:432`) is never written by 1.7.3: its record has no such field, and it was null in every stored row here.
  - Carrier: #24773 half 2b, for the seat.
